Hi team,

New rental on the Lower East Side - 88 Rivington St, Apt 3B. 1 bed / 1 bath, available Sept 1, no fee. I left the rent off the email on purpose, it's on the flyer attached. Renovated, elevator, laundry in building. Co-broke welcome, text me to show.

Marisol Vega, Brown Harris Stevens
